main.description: The repository owner likes a video. Written to the liker's own repository; deleting the record removes the like. Like other repository records it is public. Mirrors app.bsky.feed.like, scoped to OpenReel video posts.

subject.description: The social.openreel.video.post that was liked, pinned to the version seen.

createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when the like was made.
